services.desc: The seeds for the Astor Academy were planted decades ago with the long-running Astor Theatre Camp, which is now the Astor Academy Summer Camp. We need your support! Donate or volunteer. Returning for the third year, Andrew will be joining us again from New York City to lead our one-week musical theatre camp. Andrew is a NY-based actor and teacher, originally from Truro, and has been running his camps in theatres around NS for the last 17 summers! services.desc: Stop-Motion Club started in 2024 by Desmond Smyth, a local high school student who had an interest in Stop-Motion when he was younger and wanted to teach the younger generation about this animation form. Our club has expanded, not only teaching stop-motion animation but 2D frame-by-frame hand-drawn-style animation, green screen animation, and frame-by-frame pivot-stick-figure-style techniques all using your cellphone or tablet. We are excited to have amazing youth volunteers helping Desmond again this year - Easton Goodwin, Aiden Merry & Kaleb Whynott. services.desc: Come view Milton Canoe and Camera Club’s Art Exhibition in our Lower Gallery from August 6 to September 25, 2026. The opening reception for this show will be held on Thursday, August 6, 2026 at 6:30 pm. This is your first opportunity to view this beautiful show and meet the artists. Established in 1949, the Milton Canoe and Camera Club has been inspiring photographers throughout Milton and Queens County for decades. This exhibition showcases the creativity, curiosity, and unique perspectives of club members as they capture moments from the world around them.
